notes: Estimated current for the handheld (ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75) from the power log's raw columns. Every figure is an estimate: the board has no current sensor and the analysis runs with no battery (power analysis spec, sections 1 and 4). Values marked 'datasheet' are approximate readings of the ESP32-S3 datasheet's current tables; values marked 'estimate' are typical figures for this class of part, to be refined if a real measurement ever becomes possible. Currents are on the 3.3 V rail.

cpu.source: datasheet: ESP32-S3 modem-sleep current (CPU running, RF off), approximate

psram_flash.source: estimate: octal PSRAM and flash standby plus refresh

screen.source: estimate: no CO5300 or panel power data found; typical 1.4-2 inch smartwatch AMOLED figures

fixed.source: estimate: touch controller scanning (~3 mA), power chip, IMU standby, regulators, pull-ups

battery.source: estimate: 3.3 V rail through the AXP2101 buck at about 90% from a 3.7 V cell

typical_day.source: fixed weights for projected battery life, power analysis spec section 4: share of time off the dock in each stress phase's state
